Find the least positive integer $n$ such that $77$ divides $(n+2)(n+3)$.

/-- The least positive integer `n` such that `77` divides `(n + 2) * (n + 3)`.
Must be a numeric literal. -/

/-- `p07_answer` is the least element of the set of positive `n` with
`77 ∣ (n + 2) * (n + 3)`. -/
theorem p07_least_divisible :
    IsLeast {n : ℕ | 0 < n ∧ 77 ∣ (n + 2) * (n + 3)} p07_answer := by
  -- First we show that `19` satisfies the required property.
  have h19_mem : (0 < (19 : ℕ)) ∧ 77 ∣ (19 + 2) * (19 + 3) := by
    constructor
    · decide
    · have : (21 * 22) % 77 = 0 := by norm_num
      exact (Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero).mpr this

  intro n hn
  rcases hn with ⟨hn_pos, hdiv⟩
  -- From `77 ∣ (n+2)*(n+3)` we obtain divisibility by the prime factors `7` and `11`.
  have h7 : 7 ∣ (n + 2) * (n + 3) :=
    Nat.dvd_trans ⟨11, by norm_num⟩ hdiv
  have h11 : 11 ∣ (n + 2) * (n + 3) :=
    Nat.dvd_trans ⟨7, by norm_num⟩ hdiv
  have h7prime : Nat.Prime 7 := by decide
  have h11prime : Nat.Prime 11 := by decide
  have h7cases := (h7prime.dvd_mul).1 h7
  have h11cases := (h11prime.dvd_mul).1 h11
  -- Analyse the four possible ways the two primes can divide the two consecutive factors.
  rcases h7cases with h7a | h7b
  · rcases h11cases with h11a | h11b
    · -- 7 | n+2, 11 | n+2  →  n+2 ≡ 0 [MOD 77]
      have hmod : (n + 2) ≡ 0 [MOD 77] := by
        have h7mod : (n + 2) ≡ 0 [MOD 7] := (Nat.ModEq.zero_iff_dvd).2 h7a
        have h11mod : (n + 2) ≡ 0 [MOD 11] := (Nat.ModEq.zero_iff_dvd).2 h11a
        exact Nat.ModEq.of_mul_left (Nat.ModEq.trans h7mod (Nat.ModEq.of_mul_left h11mod))
      have : n = 77 * ((n + 2) / 77) - 2 := by
        rcases Nat.mod_eq_sub_mod (n + 2) 77 with ⟨k, hk⟩
        have : (n + 2) = 77 * k := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd (by
            rcases hmod with ⟨c, hc⟩; exact ⟨c, hc⟩)] using hk
        simpa [this, Nat.add_sub_cancel] using rfl
      have : 19 ≤ n := by
        have : (n + 2) ≥ 77 := by
          have : 0 < (n + 2) := Nat.succ_lt_succ hn_pos
          have : (n + 2) % 77 = 0 := (Nat.ModEq.zero_iff_dvd).1 hmod
          exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.zero_lt_one) (Nat.le_of_lt_succ this)) (Nat.le_of_lt_succ this))
        have : n ≥ 77 - 2 := Nat.sub_le_iff_le_add.mp (Nat.le_of_lt_succ this)
        exact Nat.le_trans (by decide : 19 ≤ 75) this
      exact this
    · -- 7 | n+2, 11 | n+3  →  n+2 ≡ 21 [MOD 77]
      have h7mod : (n + 2) ≡ 0 [MOD 7] := (Nat.ModEq.zero_iff_dvd).2 h7a
      have h11mod : (n + 2) ≡ 10 [MOD 11] := by
        have : (n + 3) ≡ 0 [MOD 11] := (Nat.ModEq.zero_iff_dvd).2 h11b
        have := this.sub_left 1
        simpa [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using this
      have hmod : (n + 2) ≡ 21 [MOD 77] := by
        have : (n + 2) ≡ 0 [MOD 7] := h7mod
        have : (n + 2) ≡ 10 [MOD 11] := h11mod
        have h := Nat.ModEq.of_mul_left (Nat.ModEq.trans this (Nat.ModEq.of_mul_left (Nat.ModEq.refl 10)))
        simpa using h
      have : n = 77 * ((n + 2) / 77) + 19 := by
        have hdiv : 77 ∣ (n + 2 - 21) := (Nat.ModEq.zero_iff_dvd).1 hmod
        rcases hdiv with ⟨k, hk⟩
        have : n + 2 = 77 * k + 21 := by
          simpa [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_assoc] using hk
        simpa [Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_assoc] using this
      have : 19 ≤ n := by
        have : n ≥ 19 := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (by decide : 19 < 20)
        exact this
      exact this
  · rcases h11cases with h11a | h11b
    · -- 7 | n+3, 11 | n+2  →  n+2 ≡ 55 [MOD 77]
      have h7mod : (n + 2) ≡ 6 [MOD 7] := by
        have : (n + 3) ≡ 0 [MOD 7] := (Nat.ModEq.zero_iff_dvd).2 h7b
        have := this.sub_left 1

      have h11mod : (n + 2) ≡ 0 [MOD 11] := (Nat.ModEq.zero_iff_dvd).2 h11a
      have hmod : (n + 2) ≡ 55 [MOD 77] := by

      have : n ≥ 53 := by

        admit
      exact this
